title: How Do These AI Voices Sound?
author: Arkitech-RG
selftext:
This is a short dialogue interaction using AI-generated voices. It's very Skyrim/Fallout inspired, letting the player side between two characters during the dialogue. Let me know if you have any questions or comments! It's for my open-world single-player RPG. All the audio clips were generated with AI.

  
Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5197820/GRIMLIFE/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5197820/GRIMLIFE/)

replies.author: Novaworld7
replies.body:
Haven't had a need to test something else. It does have latency because it isn't sound to sound but I'm a bit biased here as I won't touch Google, grok, or muse. I can't split myself up into that many camps... So I'm only testing what I can. Which means 11 labs, anthropic, openai, and local. 

One thing I did find wild was that you just need 30 seconds of audio for chatter, so you can just farm 11 lab voices and dump them into chatter and have them for free. Great for generating chat, it's not sound to sound speed sadly, and with my deployment it takes 5-8 seconds to get audio going due to processing / round trips etc. I can probably get it closer to 2/3 if I optimize more but I'm not too concerned with voice as Chatter is doing everything I need.
